body.name: Finite endpoint-attainment algorithm
body.construction: For the lower endpoint reserve \(r_s=\min\{u,D_T(p)\}\) on edge \((s,s)\) and \(r_t=D_T(p)-r_s\) on edge \((t,t)\); subtract these masses from the corresponding margins, complete the residual transport on \(\mathfrak R_T\) by finite augmenting paths, and on each supported edge set every observed trusted potential outcome to its factual value, every unobserved \(V_a\) to \(1\), every unobserved \(V_b\) to \(0\), all other unobserved trusted values to \(0\), and the observed untrusted \(W\)-slots to their factual values. The upper law applies the same algorithm to \(\bar p\) and reverses all outcome bits.
